title: Check Remote Host Connectivity
description: Test connectivity to a remote host using ping.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

HOST="${1:-8.8.8.8}"

if ping -c 3 -W 2 "$HOST" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "OK: $HOST is reachable."
else
    echo "ERROR: $HOST is unreachable." >&2
    exit 1
fi
